cell_type_model: Mouse cortical neurons, dentate-gyrus and cortical pyramidal-neuron models; primary cortical cultures
assay_or_perturbation: Sema3F/Nrp2/Plxna3 loss-of-function, neuronal spine and mEPSC phenotyping, AMPAR surface homeostatic-scaling assays, and Nrp2 palmitoylation perturbation
relation_type: SEMA3F engages the NRP2/PLXNA3 holoreceptor and controls spine pruning and AMPAR homeostatic downscaling; no isolated intracellular relay was resolved
pathway_branch: SEMA3F-NRP2/PLXNA3 holoreceptor -> synapse refinement and AMPAR homeostatic scaling
limitations: The holoreceptor and exact downstream functions are supported by genetic and neuronal assays, but no unique adaptor/kinase relay or terminal TF was measured; Sema3F-NRP2 binding is not a purified binary Sema3F-PLXNA3 assay.

cell_type_model: Human aortic vascular smooth-muscle cells with endothelial Sema3G context; mouse endothelial-to-glioblastoma stem-cell models
assay_or_perturbation: Recombinant Sema3G, NRP2/PLXNA1 inhibition or knockdown, LATS1/YAP phosphorylation, verteporfin rescue, cell-cycle and migration assays; endothelial Sema3G deletion or recombinant rescue with Cdc42-WWP2 and c-MYC measurements
relation_type: SEMA3G activates an NRP2/PLXNA1 receptor-complex branch that inhibits LATS1 and activates YAP in smooth muscle, and in glioblastoma stem cells promotes Cdc42-WWP2 dissociation and c-MYC degradation
pathway_branch: SEMA3G-NRP2/PLXNA1 receptor complex -> LATS1/YAP or Cdc42-WWP2 -> vascular smooth-muscle migration/proliferation or glioblastoma stemness
limitations: The exact receptor-complex activation is supported by receptor perturbation and recombinant-ligand assays, but the studies do not provide a purified Sema3G-NRP2-PLXNA1 binding measurement or one universal downstream branch; contexts are vascular and tumor models.

cell_type_model: Developing mouse dermal lymphatic endothelium and primary mouse hippocampal neurons
assay_or_perturbation: Sema3F/Sema3G double-mutant and Nrp2/Plexin-A1/A2 genetic comparisons; separate Sema3G NRP2/Plexin-A4 synapse study; no isolated Sema3G-PLXNA2 assay
relation_type: No exact SEMA3G-NRP2/PLXNA2 edge was resolved; Plexin-A2 is a family-level SEMA3 signal transducer in a mixed Sema3F/Sema3G context
pathway_branch: SEMA3G-NRP2/Plexin-A family lymphatic or synaptic comparator branch; PLXNA2-specific Sema3G relay unresolved
limitations: The lymphatic study uses combined Sema3f/Sema3g genetics and Plexin-A1/A2 perturbation, while the exact neuronal Sema3G study assigns the response to Plexin-A4. Family-level Plexin-A similarity was not promoted to this exact pair; no terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Mouse B cells and platelets; human platelet and immune-cell comparator systems
assay_or_perturbation: Sema4D/CD100 stimulation, CD72 immunoprecipitation, SHP-1 association/dissociation, BCR signaling and homeostasis assays, platelet activation and Sema4D-deficient thrombosis phenotyping
relation_type: SEMA4D directly engages CD72 and releases the CD72-associated inhibitory phosphatase SHP-1, tuning BCR and platelet-associated immune signaling
pathway_branch: SEMA4D-CD72 -> CD72 ITIM/SHP-1 disengagement -> BCR sensitivity, B-cell homeostasis, and platelet responses
limitations: CD72 signaling depends on BCR or platelet activation context and receptor phosphorylation state; the studies do not define a single kinase-to-TF branch or a terminal TF endpoint.

cell_type_model: Primary mouse hippocampal neurons; HEK293 and human breast-carcinoma receptor-expression systems
assay_or_perturbation: Sema4D stimulation, Plexin-B1/ErbB2 co-immunoprecipitation, ErbB2 kinase-domain and dominant-negative perturbation, receptor phosphorylation, RhoA assays, and growth-cone or migration phenotyping
relation_type: SEMA4D signals through PLXNB1-associated ERBB2 transactivation; ERBB2 is a receptor-complex kinase component, not an isolated direct Sema4D-binding receptor
pathway_branch: SEMA4D-PLXNB1 -> ERBB2 phosphorylation/transactivation -> LARG/PDZ-RhoGEF-RhoA -> growth-cone collapse or context-dependent migration
limitations: The exact Sema4D contact is PLXNB1; ERBB2 is the associated kinase partner. The row therefore preserves a receptor-complex edge and does not claim direct Sema4D-ERBB2 binding; no terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Human breast-carcinoma, endothelial, and epithelial receptor-complex models; mouse comparator systems
assay_or_perturbation: Sema4D stimulation, PLXNB1-MET association and MET phosphorylation, RhoA/PDZ-RhoGEF assays, receptor exchange, migration and angiogenesis perturbations
relation_type: SEMA4D signals through a PLXNB1-MET receptor complex in which MET regulates the RhoA branch; MET is not assigned as a direct Sema4D-binding receptor
pathway_branch: SEMA4D-PLXNB1-MET complex -> MET/PLXNB1 phosphorylation -> PDZ-RhoGEF-RhoA-ROCK/Pyk2/PI3K -> endothelial or tumor-cell migration
limitations: The direct ligand-binding receptor is PLXNB1 and MET is a context-dependent receptor-tyrosine-kinase partner; the direction and output vary with ERBB2 versus MET association. No terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Mouse hippocampal neurons; HEK293 receptor-expression cells; human endothelial cells
assay_or_perturbation: Sema4D/Plexin-B1 binding and receptor stimulation; LARG/PDZ-RhoGEF, Rnd1/R-Ras, Rac and ErbB2 perturbation; RhoA, MAPK, PLCgamma, PI(4,5)P2, growth-cone and tube-formation assays
relation_type: SEMA4D directly activates PLXNB1 and engages RhoA/R-Ras/Rac, MAPK, and receptor-tyrosine-kinase-associated branches
pathway_branch: SEMA4D-PLXNB1 -> R-RasGAP/Rnd1, Rac, LARG/PDZ-RhoGEF-RhoA, ERBB2 or MAPK -> cytoskeletal collapse, migration, and angiogenesis
limitations: PLXNB1 signaling is strongly co-receptor and cell-context dependent, with distinct R-Ras, Rac, RhoA, MAPK, and ERBB2 branches; no terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Mouse and human neutrophils, endothelial cells, monocyte-endothelial adhesion systems
assay_or_perturbation: Membrane Sema4D-Plexin-B2 binding, recombinant Plexin-B2 treatment, Sema4D-deficient cells, Rac1 activation and NET/oxidative-burst assays, adhesion blocking
relation_type: Membrane SEMA4D directly binds PLXNB2 and can signal through its extracellular/cellular interaction to suppress Rac1-dependent neutrophil activation or promote cell adhesion
pathway_branch: SEMA4D-PLXNB2 -> SEMA4D intracellular-domain or PLXNB2-associated Rac1 regulation -> NET/oxidative-burst suppression or monocyte-endothelial adhesion
limitations: The strongest functional study uses membrane Sema4D on neutrophils and recombinant receptor on endothelial cells, so direction and cell-cell geometry matter; a canonical PLXNB2 adaptor/kinase relay and terminal TF were not measured.

cell_type_model: COS and NIH-3T3 fibroblasts, epithelial and primary endothelial cells, MLP-29 cells expressing PLXNB3
assay_or_perturbation: Sema5A-AP binding and Scatchard analysis to PLXNB3, oligomerized ligand collapse, PLXNB3-dependent MET immunoprecipitation/phosphorylation, siRNA and migration assays
relation_type: SEMA5A engages a PLXNB3-MET receptor complex and triggers MET signaling; MET is a receptor-complex kinase partner rather than a demonstrated isolated Sema5A-binding receptor
pathway_branch: SEMA5A-PLXNB3 -> MET autophosphorylation -> receptor-associated motility/collapse and migration
limitations: Direct ligand binding is strongest for PLXNB3, while MET activation requires PLXNB3 expression and is not evidence of direct Sema5A-MET binding; outputs vary between engineered and primary endothelial/cancer-like models. No terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Developing mouse cochlea, hair cells, and type-I spiral ganglion neurons
assay_or_perturbation: Sema5B-Fc stimulation, Sema5b knockout, Plxna1 conditional loss, receptor expression and three-dimensional spiral-ganglion branch reconstruction
relation_type: SEMA5B activates PLXNA1-dependent axon-branch refinement; a unique intracellular adaptor or kinase relay was not resolved
pathway_branch: SEMA5B-PLXNA1 -> spiral-ganglion terminal-branch restriction and auditory wiring refinement
limitations: The primary study demonstrates receptor dependence and a ligand-induced neuronal phenotype rather than purified binary binding or a defined PLXNA1 cytosolic relay; Plexin-A3 is also expressed and was not the assigned functional receptor.

cell_type_model: Chick commissural neurons and floorplate; developing chick cardiac neural crest and mouse comparator systems
assay_or_perturbation: Sema6B/PLXNA2 binding, cis/trans interaction assays, Sema6B cytoplasmic truncation and rescue, in ovo RNAi, commissural-axon and neural-crest migration phenotyping
relation_type: The exact proteins interact, but the primary study assigns PLXNA2 as a ligand for the SEMA6B receptor in the relevant reverse-signaling geometry rather than SEMA6B as the PLXNA2 ligand
pathway_branch: PLXNA2 -> SEMA6B reverse-receptor signaling -> post-crossing commissural axon navigation; the queued SEMA6B-PLXNA2 ligand orientation remains unresolved
limitations: Direct binding and function are real but orientation is opposite to the submitted ligand-receptor direction, and the receptor's intracellular Sema6B tail is required for rescue. No direct Sema6B-PLXNA2 forward relay or terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Mouse neural and immune models, cultured neurons/axons, and integrin alpha1beta1 systems
assay_or_perturbation: Sema7A-integrin binding/adhesion, integrin-blocking and loss-of-function assays, MAPK/FAK pathway readouts, axon outgrowth, dendritic growth, and immune-response phenotyping
relation_type: SEMA7A engages the ITGA1/ITGB1 integrin heterodimer and couples adhesion to FAK/MAPK-dependent cellular responses
pathway_branch: SEMA7A-ITGA1/ITGB1 -> integrin adhesion/FAK-MAPK -> axon outgrowth, dendritic structure, and immune cytokine outputs
limitations: The exact receptor is the alpha1beta1 heterodimer; neither ITGA1 nor ITGB1 alone is promoted to an isolated receptor claim. Isoform, membrane anchoring, and neural/immune context affect branch strength; no terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Developing rat nervous system; mouse neonatal olfactory sensory neurons and mitral/tufted cells; recombinant Sema7A/PlexinC1 ectodomains
assay_or_perturbation: Sema7A-PlexinC1 crystal structure and biophysics, cell-surface interaction, knockout, reconstitution/rescue, activity-dependent synapse and dendrite phenotyping
relation_type: SEMA7A directly binds PLXNC1 and is required for activity-dependent olfactory synapse assembly; a pair-specific intracellular relay was not resolved
pathway_branch: SEMA7A-PLXNC1 -> cell-recognition/post-synaptic assembly -> olfactory synapse formation and dendrite selection
limitations: The strongest exact molecular evidence is structural, while the functional study is neonatal olfactory and activity dependent; no PLXNC1 adaptor/kinase or terminal TF endpoint was measured.

species: human; rabbit comparator; mammalian cell systems
cell_type_model: Purified human PAI-1/LRP1 domains, cultured endothelial and macrophage-like cells, and uPA/tPA-PAI-1 endocytosis models
assay_or_perturbation: PAI-1/LRP1 fluorescence binding and mutagenesis, receptor-cluster mapping, antibody/RAP blockade, PAI-1 complex internalization, macrophage migration and clearance assays
relation_type: SERPINE1 directly binds LRP1 in free and protease-complexed forms and supports LRP1-dependent uptake/clearance; no isolated intracellular LRP1 relay was demonstrated
pathway_branch: SERPINE1-LRP1 -> LRP1-mediated endocytosis/clearance of PAI-1 or uPA/tPA-PAI-1 complexes
limitations: PAI-1 binding and endocytosis are strongly affected by protease occupancy, uPAR bridging, receptor clusters, and cell type; uptake/clearance is not evidence for a canonical kinase or terminal-TF relay.

cell_type_model: HEK293 receptor-expression cells, mouse RAW264.7 macrophages, endothelial SVEC4-10 cells, and neuronal 661W cells
assay_or_perturbation: PEDF binding to PLXDC1-expressing cells, extracellular-domain deletion and copurification, receptor oligomerization/FRET, PLXDC1 knockdown/overexpression, intracellular-tail mutation, and IL-10 secretion or cell-response assays
relation_type: SERPINF1/PEDF directly binds PLXDC1, dissociates receptor homooligomers, and activates PLXDC1-dependent cell-type-specific responses
pathway_branch: SERPINF1-PLXDC1 -> receptor oligomer dissociation/cytoplasmic-tail signaling -> macrophage IL-10 and endothelial/neuronal PEDF responses
limitations: PLXDC1 is an atypical single-pass receptor with cell-type-specific outputs and no established canonical kinase; the primary study does not resolve a universal intracellular adaptor or terminal TF.

cell_type_model: HEK293 receptor-expression cells, mouse RAW264.7 macrophages, endothelial SVEC4-10 cells, and neuronal 661W cells
assay_or_perturbation: PEDF binding to PLXDC2-expressing cells, extracellular-domain deletion and copurification, receptor oligomerization/FRET, PLXDC2 knockdown/overexpression and cytoplasmic-tail deletion, and IL-10 or cell-response assays
relation_type: SERPINF1/PEDF directly binds PLXDC2, alters receptor homooligomerization, and activates PLXDC2-dependent cell-type-specific responses
pathway_branch: SERPINF1-PLXDC2 -> receptor oligomer dissociation/cytoplasmic-tail signaling -> macrophage IL-10 and endothelial/neuronal PEDF responses
limitations: PLXDC2 and PLXDC1 have overlapping but distinct cellular roles; the study does not establish a universal kinase/adaptor relay or a terminal TF for the exact PLXDC2 edge.

cell_type_model: Mouse 2H11 and MS1 endothelial cells, recombinant human proteins, and endothelial nuclear extracts
assay_or_perturbation: SFRP2-FZD5 co-localization/co-immunoprecipitation, recombinant FZD5-Fc binding/ELISA, FZD5 knockdown, intracellular calcium and tube-formation assays, calcineurin inhibition, and NFATc3 nuclear-protein analysis
relation_type: SFRP2 directly binds and activates FZD5-dependent calcineurin/NFATC3 signaling that promotes endothelial angiogenic function
pathway_branch: SFRP2-FZD5 -> calcium/calcineurin -> NFATC3 nuclear activation -> endothelial tube formation and angiogenesis
limitations: The primary study uses endothelial and engineered receptor systems and does not define how SFRP2 engagement differs from Wnt/FZD signaling or establish a universal FZD5 relay outside angiogenic endothelium.

cell_type_model: Human NSCLC single-cell tumor/adjacent tissue; primary human monocyte-to-macrophage cultures in SP-A family comparator work
assay_or_perturbation: Exact SFTPA1-TLR2 searches; the queue anchor is a computational ligand-receptor prediction in single-cell data, while SP-A family studies measured macrophage TLR modulation without isolating the SFTPA1 isoform as a binding ligand
relation_type: No qualifying exact SFTPA1-TLR2 binding, receptor activation, receptor-proximal relay, or exact-pair functional perturbation was established
pathway_branch: SFTPA family/TLR2 expression and signaling comparator; exact SFTPA1-TLR2 molecular edge unresolved
limitations: PMID:31033233 lists SFTPA1-TLR2 as a computational interaction, not a primary binding or perturbation result; SP-A family evidence cannot be used to promote the exact SFTPA1 isoform pair, and no terminal TF was assigned.

cell_type_model: Primary mouse alveolar macrophages, SIRPA-transfected fibroblasts, SIRPA mutant systems, and apoptotic-cell phagocytosis models
assay_or_perturbation: SP-D/SIRPA binding with blocking antibodies and receptor mutants; SHP-1 deficiency or inhibition, RhoA/ROCK inhibition, and apoptotic-cell phagocytosis assays
relation_type: SFTPD binds SIRPA and suppresses alveolar-macrophage phagocytosis through an SHP-1/RhoA receptor-proximal inhibitory branch
pathway_branch: SFTPD-SIRPA -> SHP-1/RhoA-ROCK inhibitory signaling -> reduced apoptotic-cell phagocytosis
limitations: The study tests SP-A and SP-D collectins together and SIRPA receptor perturbations; exact collectin oligomerization, collagen-domain presentation, and macrophage state affect potency. No terminal TF was measured.

cell_type_model: Recombinant human SP-D/TLR ectodomain systems; rat chondrocytes and osteoarthritis cartilage; macrophage and inflammatory comparator models
assay_or_perturbation: Ca2+-dependent SP-D binding to soluble TLR4 and TLR4/MD-2, SP-D knockdown or recombinant rescue, TLR4 blockade, PI3K/Akt and NF-kB phosphorylation, cytokine and cartilage phenotyping
relation_type: SFTPD binds the TLR4/MD-2 complex and inhibits LPS/TLR4-associated inflammatory signaling; this is an antagonistic receptor-complex edge, not a claim of direct TLR4 activation
pathway_branch: SFTPD-TLR4/MD-2 -> TLR4 antagonism -> PI3K/Akt and NF-kB attenuation -> reduced inflammatory cytokines and tissue damage
limitations: The biochemical study uses soluble TLR ectodomains, while functional work uses rat cartilage and recombinant or knockdown SP-D; LPS, MD-2, collectin oligomerization, and cell context determine the direction and magnitude. Phospho-NF-kB was measured, but no terminal TF transcriptional endpoint was assigned.

cell_type_model: Mouse and chick neural-tube patterning, zebrafish spinal-cord oligodendrocyte progenitors, and mammalian coreceptor-expression/reconstitution systems
assay_or_perturbation: SHH-BOC binding-domain and coreceptor assays, Boc loss-of-function/rescue, neural-tube patterning, oligodendrocyte progenitor maintenance, SCUBE2-SHH relay, and Nkx2.2/Olig2 pathway readouts
relation_type: SHH binds BOC as a Hedgehog coreceptor and BOC-dependent receptor-complex relay sustains canonical GLI-pathway and ventral progenitor outputs
pathway_branch: SHH-BOC/PTCH1 -> SMO/ciliary Hedgehog relay -> NKX2-2 and OLIG2 ventral progenitor or oligodendrocyte programs
limitations: BOC can act as a positive or context-dependent decoy/coreceptor, and some assays measure combined GAS1/CDON/BOC activity rather than isolated BOC; neural patterning and oligodendrocyte outputs are species and stage dependent.

cell_type_model: Mouse Cdon-null MEFs, mammalian receptor/coreceptor reconstitution systems, human HPE variant studies, and developing neural-tube models
assay_or_perturbation: SHH binding to CDON fibronectin domains, CDON/PTCH1/GAS1 association, Cdon loss and rescue, SCUBE2-SHH coreceptor relay, and Ptch1/Gli1 qRT-PCR
relation_type: SHH directly binds CDON and requires CDON-associated Hedgehog receptor-complex organization for downstream pathway activation
pathway_branch: SHH-CDON/PTCH1 -> SMO/ciliary relay -> GLI1/Ptch1 transcription and ventral neural patterning
limitations: CDON is a coreceptor/ligand-presenting component rather than the sole signaling receptor; the studies resolve CDON binding and pathway competence but not one universal CDON-specific intracellular adaptor.

cell_type_model: Mouse presomitic mesoderm and neural-tube models, chick neural-tube patterning, and mammalian SCUBE2-SHH/coreceptor systems
assay_or_perturbation: SHH-N/GAS1 binding, co-immunoprecipitation and affinity measurements, Gas1 expression or loss-of-function, ventral neural patterning, and lipid-dependent coreceptor relay assays
relation_type: SHH directly binds GAS1, which modulates SHH availability and participates in a coreceptor-to-PTCH1 relay with measured ventral neural transcriptional outputs
pathway_branch: SHH-GAS1 -> GAS1/PTCH1 ligand handoff or sequestration -> SMO/GLI pathway -> NKX2-2 ventral patterning
limitations: GAS1 can antagonize or promote SHH depending on presentation, lipid state, and tissue; combined coreceptor genetics do not isolate one universal GAS1 intracellular relay, although the exact SHH-GAS1 binding edge is direct.

cell_type_model: Mouse/chick commissural neurons and spinal-cord floorplate axon-guidance models
assay_or_perturbation: Gpc1 knockdown and rescue, Shh-insensitive GPC1 mutant, HS-chain/core-protein perturbation, Hhip expression, and pre/post-crossing commissural-axon guidance assays
relation_type: SHH binds or is presented by GPC1 as a heparan-sulfate coreceptor to induce HHIP and switch post-crossing axon responsiveness; no unique intracellular relay was resolved
pathway_branch: SHH-GPC1/PTCH1 presentation -> HHIP induction -> post-crossing commissural-axon repulsion
limitations: GPC1 is a proteoglycan coreceptor/presentation factor and the study distinguishes transcription-dependent post-crossing from transcription-independent pre-crossing Shh guidance; HHIP is a target gene, not a terminal TF.

cell_type_model: Recombinant HHIP/SHH biochemical systems, NIH/3T3 and PANC-1 co-culture, neonatal mouse lung and human bronchopulmonary-dysplasia comparator models
assay_or_perturbation: HHIP-SHH direct binding/structural and affinity assays, HHIP deletion or Fc-fused rescue, SHH pathway reporter/qRT-PCR, Gli1 measurements, and lung alveologenesis phenotyping
relation_type: HHIP directly sequesters SHH and antagonizes Hedgehog signaling; the exact edge is inhibitory ligand sequestration rather than productive receptor activation
pathway_branch: SHH-HHIP sequestration -> reduced PTCH1/SMO signaling -> reduced GLI1 pathway output and context-dependent alveologenesis
limitations: HHIP is a secreted antagonist and not a canonical signaling receptor; the lung phenotypes include broader Hh-IGF1 and stromal effects, while the direct biochemical edge and Gli1 inhibition are the exact-pair evidence.
